title: phpMyAdmin login interface disclosed
description: The response is the phpMyAdmin login form: the pma_username field and the phpMyAdmin asset identify the database administration interface. Reaching it means the MySQL console is exposed to this network position.
remediation: Do not publish phpMyAdmin beyond the management network. Put it behind an authenticating proxy and an IP allow-list, and keep the version patched.
limitation: One response body. The rule reports the login page; it does not attempt a login and cannot show which database privileges would follow.

observation.body: <html><body><form method="post" action="index.php"><input name="pma_username" autocomplete="username"><input name="pma_password" type="password"></form><!-- phpMyAdmin 5.2.1 --></body></html>
